About Holo's Arcade

Welcome to the Arcade — a growing collection of quick, fun games you can play anywhere, right in your browser. Puzzle, trivia, party, and brain games, with something new added all the time.

Right now you're in the Glitch Lab, our testing zone. Glitch Squad testers play first, find the glitches, and help shape what launches. Play, earn Glitch XP, climb levels, and tell us what you think.

No downloads. No fuss. Just press start.

Holo's Arcade is made by Holo Productions.

    Trophy Case

    Trophy Case — your stamps & fun challenges

    Level 1 · 0 Glitch XP · 👑 Final Boss

    This is your Trophy Case — no missions, nothing you have to do. Every game you report on earns a stamp in your collection below — just tap Report back after you play. The challenges are silly little dares for when you feel like one — skip them all and just play what you want, in any order, any time. That's the whole point of the arcade.

    Pick one if you dare

    🎲

    🎲Mystery Spin

    No choosing! Let the arcade pick a game for you at random.

    🏆Beat Your Best

    Replay a favourite and try to top your own score. Yesterday-you is the boss.

    🗺️Shelf Surfer

    Try one game from a shelf you've never touched before.

    🌙Cozy Mode

    Find the calmest, cosiest game in the arcade. Blanket optional.

    Your stamp collection

    One stamp for every different game you've reported on. Grey stamps are games still waiting — only if you fancy them. There's no finish line and no rush.

    Your play calendar

    Gold days are days you played. It fills in as you play — saved on this device only.

    Trophies

    Two hidden friends — Eevee and Gizmo — hide somewhere new in the arcade every day. Find and tap both of them on the same day (watch them dance!) to earn the Egg Hunter trophy.

    Your reports

    Every report you've filed with the Report back button, grouped by game. Reports live in this browser on this device only — nothing phones home. 🤫 To share yours with Holo, copy them below and paste them wherever you two chat — she'll pop them into the feedback sheet.

    Copied! Paste it to Holo — thanks for playing! 💛

    Legal & Policies

    Draft rules. They may change.

    Legal & Policies — Holo's Arcade

    Last updated: 2026-11-20

    Welcome to Holo's Arcade. These pages explain, in plain words, the rules for playing our games, what information the games keep, and how chat works. Please read them. By playing, you agree to these rules.

    1. Terms of Use

    Play for fun. Holo's Arcade games are for entertainment only.

    Play money only. Some games (like poker) use pretend chips. There is no real gambling here: you cannot win or lose real money, and there are no cash prizes. Pretend chips have no cash value and cannot be bought, sold, or exchanged.

    Your account and friend code. If a game gives you an account or a friend code, keep it to yourself. You are responsible for what happens under your code. Do not share your code with strangers.

    Fair play. Play honestly. No cheating, no bots, no scripts or hacks, no exploiting bugs to gain an advantage, and no helping others cheat. If you find a bug, please report it instead of using it.

    Rule-breakers. We can suspend or remove any player who breaks these rules — including cheating, bullying, or abusing chat — without notice. Scores earned by cheating can be removed.

    Changes. We may update these rules as the arcade grows. The newest version on this page is the one that applies.

    Availability. Games are provided "as is." We do our best to keep them running, but we cannot promise they will always be available or error-free, and scores or progress may occasionally be lost.

    2. Privacy

    What the games store. To make the games work, we may store:

    • Your scores, best results, and game progress
    • Your friend code and friend list (if you use one)
    • Chat messages, kept so reported messages can be reviewed for moderation

    On your device. Many games save progress in your browser's local storage on your own device. That information stays on your device unless a feature below sends it to us.

    Online features. Some features may store scores and friend lists online so they can work across devices.

    No selling data. We do not sell your information. Ever.

    Only what is needed. We do not collect personal information beyond what the games need to work. We do not ask for your real name, address, or payment details to play free games.

    Your choices. You can clear your browser's local storage at any time to remove on-device progress. If you want online data tied to your friend code removed, contact us and we will delete it.

    3. Chat Policy

    Our chat rules exist so everyone can play without being bullied. They apply to every game with chat.

    Safeguards built in:

    • Word filter — slurs and profanity are blocked automatically.
    • Mute, block, and report — one tap. Reported messages are saved so they can be reviewed.
    • Friends-only option — you can limit chat to people you have added as friends.
    • Rate limits — messages are limited so nobody can flood or spam the chat.
    • No stranger DMs — chat happens at the table or in the room only. There are no private messages from strangers.

    Zero tolerance for bullying. Harassment, threats, hate speech, and bullying are not allowed. A report that is reviewed and confirmed means a chat ban. Serious or repeated abuse can mean losing access to the games entirely.

    Voice and camera. Voice and camera are off by default and only ever on if you choose to turn them on. They are for private tables with friends, not public rooms. You can turn them off at any time.

    Be kind. Behind every player name is a person. If someone is bothering you, mute, block, and report — do not engage.

    4. Age Note

    Holo's Arcade games are family-friendly. Chat features (text, voice, camera) are recommended for players 13 and older, with parental guidance for younger players. Parents and guardians: please supervise younger children's play, use the friends-only chat option, and review these policies with them.

    5. Health Note

    Holo's Arcade games are entertainment. They are not medical advice and do not replace advice from a doctor or other qualified health professional. Some games mention health and fitness topics, but anything you read in a game is general information only. Talk to your own clinician about your personal health decisions.

    Questions about these policies? Contact us through the arcade's contact page.

    This is a draft prepared for review. It is not legal advice. A qualified lawyer should review and finalize these policies before the arcade opens to the public.

      Someone's in a mood — and she's charging. Help your herder dog calm her down: fetch rope toys to fill the calm meter (5 pips), grab treats for a speed boost, and dodge when she paws the ground and snorts — that's her charge warning. Calm her and she'll amble back to her pen, then get mad all over again, faster. Move your dog by dragging / touching the field, or with the arrow keys / WASD.

        ✦

        How to play

          Quick answers for getting in.

          How do I register?

          Fill in the form: a username, your email, a password (6 or more characters, typed twice), and your invite code. Tick the Terms box and tap create. Then sign in with your email and password.

          Already registered? Tap “Already a player? Press start” under the form.

          How does email verification work?

          We send a verification email when you register. Tap the link in it, then sign in. No email after a few minutes? Check your spam or junk folder.

          How do I sign in next time?

          Type your email and password and tick the Terms & Policies box. Tick “Remember me” to stay signed in on this device.

          Forgot my password, what now?

          Tap Forgot password and we will email you a link to set a new one. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive. After you reset, sign in and verify your email again.

          You can also start it right here:

          Lost access to your email?

          If you can't get into the email on your account, send us a recovery request. We'll verify it's you and move your account to your new email — your Code Name, Glitch XP and progress come with you.

          What are the password rules?

          Use 6 or more characters. Type the same password twice when you register — both copies must match. Your invite code is only needed when you register.

          Having trouble registering?
          • Check your invite code spelling.
          • Use a password with 6 or more characters, typed the same way twice.
          • Check your email is typed right.
          • Tick the Terms and Policies box.
          • No verification email? Check your spam or junk folder.

          Still stuck? Use Need help

          Tap the button below and pick what is going wrong. We read every report.

          FAQ

          FAQ — Holo's Arcade

          Quick answers. Still stuck? Tap Report back and we will take a look.

          How do I play?

          Everything plays right here. Browse the shelves or search by name, then tap ▶ Play. Play any game you like, in any order.

          Where are How to Play and the Rules?

          Inside each game: ❓ How to play shows quick steps, and 📜 Rules explains scoring. Every game has both.

          What about difficulty and modes?

          Most games let you pick a difficulty on the start screen. Start easy and step up when it feels too easy.

          What's a practice round?

          Practice lets you learn first. Practice scores are not saved. Tap ▶ Play for real when you are ready.

          Do practice rounds earn Glitch XP?

          No — practice is just for learning: untimed, and no Glitch XP, scores, or streaks are saved from practice.

          How do I leave feedback or report a bug?

          Tap Report back. For a review, give stars and a quick note. For a bug, tick 🐞 Something's broken and say what broke. We read every report.

          Can I attach a screenshot to my report?

          Yes! In Report back, tap 📷 Add a screenshot and pick a picture. It gets shrunk automatically and travels with your report. Tap the × on the preview to remove it. Drafts keep the screenshot too.

          What is Glitch XP?

          Glitch XP is achievement points you earn by playing — they build your Level and are never spent. Your XP and Level stay with you at launch. Spendable coins come later with the shop: Glitch Gold for testers and Duck Bucks for everyone — not active yet. You also earn a stamp for every game you report on, plus badges as you file reports.

          Which devices can I play on?

          Any phone, tablet, or computer with a browser. Sign in with your email and password on up to 5 devices. Your scores and Glitch XP stay on the device you played on.

          How many devices can I use?

          Your account works on up to 5 devices — phone, tablet, or computer. Need a 6th? Contact Holo and she can free up a spot for you.

          How do I put Holo's Arcade on my phone?

          Optional. Add a shortcut so the Arcade is one tap away.

          iPhone (Safari):

          • Open the Arcade in Safari.
          • Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
          • Tap Add to Home Screen.
          • Tap Add. The Arcade icon appears on your home screen.

          Android (Chrome):

          • Open the Arcade in Chrome.
          • Tap the three dots menu at the top right.
          • Tap Add to Home screen, or Install app if your phone shows it.
          • Tap Add or Install. The Arcade icon appears on your home screen.
          Get the Arcade on your phone

          One tap and the Arcade lives on your home screen like an app.

          Is my progress saved if I switch phones?

          Your account works on any device. Your scores and Glitch XP stay on the device you played on.

          Does my Glitch XP follow me to another device?

          Not yet — it saves on each device for now. One shared bank is coming in the future. Don't worry, you won't lose them.

          Can I merge my phone and laptop progress?

          Coming in the future — when the shared bank arrives, your devices merge into one account. Don't worry, you won't lose your Glitch XP or progress.

          Why did my Glitch XP not count?

          Practice rounds do not save scores or Glitch XP. When you are ready to earn Glitch XP that counts, tap Play for real in the game instead of Practice.

          Can I play offline?

          Mostly, yes. Open the page once while you are online so the games can load. After that you can keep playing without a connection, and your progress saves on your device.

          How do I get the Game of the Day bonus?

          Play the Game of the Day at the top of the home page. The first play each day earns bonus Glitch XP, and back to back days build a streak.

          Can I invite friends?

          No — not in the beta. Inviting friends will be on the live side. In the beta, testers join by invite only.

          Can I add friends in the beta?

          Yes — head to Friends, search a Code Name, and send a friend request. When they accept (it lands in their Inbox), you're friends on every device.

          Will my Code Name transfer when the Arcade goes live?

          Yes — your account and Code Name carry straight over to the live Arcade.

          Can I change my Code Name?

          Send support a request and we'll sort it out. Type the new Code Name you want, check it's free, then send the request.

          Can I verify with my phone?

          Coming soon — you'll be able to add a phone number to your account so we can text you a code to prove it's you (handy if you ever lose email access).

          Who sees my reviews and bug reports?

          We read every review and bug report.

          Why does a game have no sound on iPhone?

          iPhones keep game sound off until you tap. Tap the game once to wake the sound up. Also check the silent switch on the side of your phone, and turn the volume up.

          How do I delete my account?

          Scroll to the Your Arcade section and find the Your account box. Tap Delete my account, enter your password, type DELETE, then tap Delete forever. It is permanent and signs you out.

          Where do replies to my reports go?

          Tap the envelope at the top to open your Inbox. Replies to your reports, friend requests, saved drafts and news land there — new testers also get a mission briefing message, and the tour walks you through it step by step on your first sign-in. Tap a message to read it; archive it when you're done. The pink number means something new is waiting.

          Can I choose which emails I get?

          Yes. In Settings, under Email notifications, you can turn each kind on or off: Messages, Notifications, Friend requests, and Report replies. They all start on. Emails come from Holo's Arcade (topsecret@holosarcade.ca).

          Can I sign out on all my devices at once?

          Yes. In Your account, tap Sign out everywhere. That signs you out on this device right away, and on every other device signed in to your account the next time it opens the Arcade or refreshes its sign-in. You will need your email and password to sign back in.

          How do I change my password?

          In Your account, under Change password, pop in your current password, then your new one twice. New passwords need 6 or more characters. After a change, you will verify your email again next time you sign in.

          Can I turn game sound or music off?

          Yes. In Settings, under Sound and music, turn Sound effects or Music off. Both start on. Games follow these switches automatically.

          Can I sort the Library?

          Yes — use the Sort buttons at the top of the Library: Category (shelves), A–Z, Z–A, Most played (your most-opened games first), or Newest (recently added games first). Sorting works together with the shelf filters and search. Games added in the last 30 days wear a gold New badge.

          Keyboard shortcuts

          On a computer: Esc closes popups and games. In the Game Menu, the up and down arrow keys move between buttons and Enter picks one. Tab moves through buttons anywhere on the page.

          Can I stop friend requests?

          Yes. In Settings, turn Accept friend requests off. Other testers then see that you are not accepting requests, and new requests to you are blocked. Friends you already have stay.

          How do I hide 18+ games from kids?

          In Settings, under 18+ games, turn Hide 18+ games on. Kings Cup Party, Cup Toss Party and Never Have I Ever Party disappear from the Library, search, Categories and Game of the Day. Turning them back on needs the parent PIN. Your date of birth (asked when you register) hides them automatically until your 18th birthday, when they switch on by themselves. If the account is under 18, or has no date of birth on file, there is no switch at all — the 18+ games stay hidden.

          What is the parent PIN?

          A 4-digit PIN that unlocks the 18+ games after they have been hidden. Set it up in Settings under 18+ games. Setting or changing the PIN always needs email verification first: we email you a link, and only after you tap it can you set or change the PIN. Turning the games off is free and never needs the PIN. The PIN never unlocks 18+ games for an account under 18 — or one with no date of birth on file.

          Can someone open an 18+ game from a direct link?

          No. The game pages check the same age and hide settings as the hub: if you are under 18, or 18+ games are hidden on this device, the page sends you back to the hub instead of loading the game. Adults with the games switched on can still play them from the hub as normal.

          How do I download my data?

          In Settings, tap Download my data. You get a file with your scores, Glitch XP, favourites and reports. This downloads data saved on this device only.

          Can't remember a game you played?

          Open the Library and tap the Recently Played pill. Your last 20 games show up there, newest first, so you can find the one you mean and tap its duck to favourite it. The list lives on this device.

No owner tools, no 👑 Final Boss, no Glitch XP wallet in the tester view itself.
